articles.title: US, Chinese Robotaxi Rivals Race for Europe
articles.description: Europe is emerging as a key battleground for the global robotaxi industry as US and Chinese companies look to expand autonomous driving beyond their home markets. Frank McCleary, a partner at Arthur D. Little, discusses Europe’s fragmented but evolving regulatory landscape, why Chinese operators see an opportunity there as the US remains largely closed to them, and whether experience gained deploying autonomous vehicles in China translates to cities overseas. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: ASML Struggles to Keep Up With High AI Demand
articles.description: ASML is racing to expand capacity as demand for the advanced chipmaking equipment needed to power the AI boom stretches years into the future. Intesa Sanpaolo analyst Antonella Frongillo discusses why semiconductor equipment makers are already talking with customers about demand into 2029 and 2030, and why she sees further upside for ASML despite uncertainty around its China business and new regulatory restrictions. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
